title: Development-first property summary and explicit FAR meanings
objective: Apply architect feedback across residential property contexts while preserving source evidence and unsupported-calculation states.
business_reason: Architects need development limits first and existing-building facts separately.
inputs: docs/PRODUCT_FLOW_AND_AI_BOUNDARIES.md sections Main analyst interface,UI rules
outputs: Development limits summary shared by overview, zoning and report; source-reference/evaluated values remain distinct.
Existing-building information collapsible on overview and retained in property facts/evidence/report.
Domain-context-independent presentation tests and real-parcel source/value checks.

acceptance_scenarios.invariants: Source values, canonical contracts and calculation safeguards preserved.
acceptance_scenarios.execution: Component tests, source comparisons and browser walkthrough
acceptance_scenarios.cleanup: In-memory fixture state only; no production records modified

progress_log.message: Acceptance scenarios recorded; independent D-063 intake review passed; implementation begins in isolated UI worktree.

Independent review found one selector and evidence-association defect cluster: malformed traces, conflicting cap, missing fingerprints, cross-family units and duplicate traces. Rework all variants with negative tests before refreezing.
G5 independently confirms the same five selector and association defects already routed as one bounded rework cluster.
